name: Aiden Furin
source:
One of AEGIS top agents and a fighter for freedom from the syndicates. Orphaned as a teenager as a result of of their greed, Aiden has dedicated his life to putting a stop to their tyranny.
Happily married to Luna, his teenage crush and his personal hero.
